alkylzinc salts are a convenient and inexpensive starting material for the synthesis of novel zinc carboxylate and oxocarboxlate clusters with a high potential for the design of new MOF structures.

the alkylzinc reagents can be used to prepare new zinc carboxylate clusters and that the reaction of these clusters with O2 or S8 is an efficient route to the corresponding zinc oxo or sulfido clusters, which are important building blocks for MOFs.
